_comment: Starter UNSPSC-aligned keyword map for spend_categorizer.py. Keys are spend categories loosely aligned to UNSPSC Segments/Families; values are lowercase substrings matched case-insensitively against line-item descriptions. Order matters: the FIRST category with a keyword hit wins. Tune keywords to your own PO/AP free-text before trusting the coding, and map to real 8-digit UNSPSC commodity codes for audited work.
